importNotes: Agent-assisted visual PDF transcription, not an automatic PDF importer. English singing translation selected by the user.

All 28 measures and both independent Tenor lines are stored. Primary timeline is Tenor 1; additionalVoices contains Tenor 2. Display intent: simultaneous capsules on one shared pitch grid, not separate staffs.
The opening measure contains two quarter-note beats; meters are 4/4 through measure 19, 6/4 in measures 20-25, then 4/4.
Pitch and rhythm were checked visually against all seven source pages; measure totals are validated independently for each voice.

Fourteen hairpins per voice are encoded with endpoints inferred from the printed Tenor staff. The tenuto mark in measure 2 is not yet encoded. See transcription/review.json. This is a transcription draft, not a complete engraving import.
Same-pitch arcs joining different printed English syllables are stored as slurs so each syllable remains articulated.
Visible title is used instead of incorrect PDF metadata title Khvalitye imya Gospodie.
ACN beat unit is an eighth note: 8 dots for 4/4 and 12 for 6/4. Original onsets, durations, and meters are unchanged.
